meaning:
συν-κάθημαι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Psa.101:6 (יָשַׁב) * ;]
to sit together or with: with dative, Act.26:30; before μετά, with genitive, Mrk.14:54.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of…
The king rose up with the governor, and Bernice, and those who sat with them.
